messages:
ravi: Quick sync — planning a tiny base-image push Wed 06:00 PT to drop CAP_NET_RAW and shrink runtime users. Will also rotate cosign signer.

emily: rolling canary? want to avoid any bake failures at scale.

ravi: yes, internal-canary then staging then prod-canary. 10m windows. will run cosign verify + a quick vuln scan after each step.

tony: KMS question: do we use the same KEK alias or create a per-cluster alias for the rewrap?

ravi: per-cluster alias. infra will provision and grant keystore-operator kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt.

emily: RBAC note: bake-runner SA still has broad rights in test-ns; will send PR to narrow to Job/Pod create. add `sec.redwood/audit=SEC-7340` annotation.

tony: incident fallback: if rewrap fails, decrypt with old KEK and re-encrypt. add explicit gcloud commands in runbook.

ops-bot: checklist: [ ] RBAC PR, [ ] KEKs created, [ ] cosign rotation, [ ] canary schedule, [ ] runbook added to SEC-7340.

emily: I'll own cosign rotation and verification in CI. ravi: please ping #release-war-room 30m prior.

ravi: will do. short preflight for rollout team:
```
# check capabilities dropped
kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop}' | grep NET_RAW && echo BAD || echo OK
# cosign verify
echo testing | cosign verify-blob -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign -
```

tony: thanks — pairing on RBAC at 2pm today.
